3fd77a7087.q: What is the core difference between health coaching and concierge medicine according to Dr Ashwari?
3fd77a7087.a: Health coaching is tedious and time-consuming, requiring ongoing behavioral and lifestyle support similar to cognitive behavioral therapy, while concierge medicine focuses on technology-driven interventions like GLP, PCSK9 injections, and full-body MRIs that patients perceive as high-value services. The disconnect is that people desire outcomes but lack the conscientiousness necessary to make sacrifices required for health coaching to work.
